gloss: to applaud; to cheer; to acclaim

definitions.gloss: to applaud; to cheer; to acclaim; to give an ovation
definitions.explanation: To express enthusiastic approval or admiration for someone's achievement or performance, either literally through clapping or figuratively through praise.

examples.japanese: ⟦{観客|かんきゃく}→観客：02556_kankyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{喝采|かっさい}を{送|おく}った。
⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧たち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{惜|お}しみない→惜しみない：22599_oshiminai⟧{喝采|かっさい}を{送|おく}った。
examples.english: They gave the players wholehearted applause.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{勇気|ゆうき}→勇気：02499_yuuki⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{世界中|せかいじゅう}→世界中：10171_sekaijuu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{喝采|かっさい}→喝采：08383_kassai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{送|おく}られた→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: His courageous actions were applauded from around the world.

notes:
A set expression combining ⟦{喝采|かっさい}→喝采：08383_kassai⟧ (cheers, applause) with ⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧ (to send). The expression carries a sense of warm, enthusiastic praise and is more literary than simple ⟦{拍手|はくしゅ}→拍手：03553_hakushu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧. Often used in news writing and formal contexts to describe acclaim for achievements.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{惜|お}しみない→惜しみない：22599_oshiminai⟧{喝采|かっさい}を{送|おく}る: to give unstinting applause
- ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{喝采|かっさい}を{送|おく}る: to give great applause
- ⟦{喝采|かっさい}→喝采：08383_kassai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{浴|あ}びる→浴びる：02844_abiru⟧: to receive applause (from the recipient's perspective)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{拍手|はくしゅ}→拍手：03553_hakushu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧: to send applause — more literal, focused on clapping
- ⟦{声援|せいえん}→声援：10153_seien⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧: to send cheers — focused on vocal support
- ⟦{称賛|しょうさん}→称賛：21287_shousan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to praise — a more general word for praising
